specification.objective: Rebuild the team administration page composition in the reference workspace language while preserving functional behavior and theme.

requirements.statement: Recompose desktop employee directory header and search as one responsive toolbar, and the selected profile overview and tabs as wide responsive groups.
Preserve employee data, loading and error states, search, filters, selection, pagination, profile tabs, employee and punch actions, accessibility and light and dark themes.
Persist the exact locked contract in docs/contracts/team-rebuild-v1.polis.json.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A desktop widget regression checks search shares the directory heading row and profile overview and tabs use available horizontal width, without exceptions.
Existing team widget tests and configured project gates pass; the persisted contract equals the lock byte-for-byte.

invariants.statement: Do not alter API calls, employee data, authorization, navigation, or theme persistence.

forbidden_states.statement: Controls or content disappear, overflow, or become inaccessible in supported responsive layouts.

inputs.statement: Existing team page, widget tests, and user-provided visual reference.

outputs.statement: Responsive team page composition and regression evidence.

failure_semantics.statement: The team_toolbar_composition regression fails on the baseline geometry and passes on the rebuilt page.
